new_today_news.headline: Where Do I Throw It? The Kitchen Dilemma of Used Cooking Oil and the Rules for Proper Disposal
new_today_news.summary: Comprehensive guide on proper used cooking oil disposal methods across municipalities, emphasizing how properly managed culinary fat undergoes industrial transformation for circular economy applications rather than disposal as waste.

new_today_news.headline: Carbon Credit Prices 2026: Current Prices by Project Type
new_today_news.summary: Market analysis showing carbon credit pricing as of August 2026, ranging from under €10/tonne for avoidance credits to €150-500+ for direct air capture. Notes increased corporate demand for high-integrity credits from verified registries.

recent_news.headline: UCO Market Intelligence: Strategic Feedstock Constraints and 2026 Pricing Dynamics
recent_news.summary: Analysis of used cooking oil market at structural intersection of aviation decarbonization mandates and waste-to-energy policies. Identifies UCO as strategically undersupplied feedstock commanding $1,045-$1,200/tonne with supply gaps of 3-5x against 2030 SAF mandates.

recent_news.headline: From Fryer to Biofuel: The Unsung Environmental Impact of Used Cooking Oil Management
recent_news.summary: Examines transition of used cooking oil from waste product to viable resource through collection systems and recycling facilities. Discusses shift from disposal to recycling as mark of growing commitment to circular economic models and sustainability.

recent_news.headline: How Corporate Dining Programs Are Meeting ESG Goals
recent_news.summary: Highlights corporate dining as visible, measurable part of ESG strategy. Notes that food waste represents significant portion of corporate emissions and emphasizes importance of timestamped, ingredient-specific data for auditable sustainability reporting.

recent_news.headline: UCO as SAF Feedstock 2026: HEFA Supply Chain, Feedstock Integrity & Regulatory Architecture
recent_news.summary: Strategic analysis of used cooking oil (UCO) as sustainable aviation fuel feedstock, detailing HEFA technology constraints and supply dynamics. Quantifies global UCO-based HEFA capacity as meeting only 3-8% of projected 2030 SAF demand, with concentration among Neste, World Energy, and Diamond Green Diesel.

recent_news.headline: Used Cooking Oil (UCO) Price & Collection Economics 2026: Market Intelligence, Trade Flows & Profitability
recent_news.summary: Market intelligence report on UCO pricing, collection economics, and feedstock sourcing strategies. Highlights Neste as world's largest SAF/renewable diesel producer; discusses Bunge-Chevron joint venture and Heartwell Renewables (Cargill-Love's JV) tallow operations in Nebraska.
